text.official_en: ...Wait, hang on.

text.jp:
ああ、鍵なら俺が預かってるぜ。
君にあげるよ。
text.official_en: I actually happen to have the key. Here, take it.

text.jp:
あいにく茶葉を切らしておりましてね。
代わりと言ってはなんですが、
こちらをどうぞお受け取りくださいな。
text.official_en: I’m afraid I’m out of tea leaves right now... Oh, but it just won’t do to serve my guests nothing! Please, have this instead.

text.jp:
あとは、伝説の名刀と名高い「佐助の刀」に
出会うことができれば、この人生に悔いはない。
text.official_en: Now if only I could see the legendary <text style="italic">Sasuke’s Blade</>, I could die a happy man.
text.real_en: If I could just see the legendary sword known as Sasuke's Blade, I'd have no regrets left in life.

text.jp:
あなたたち、ミシディアから来たでしょう。
匂いで分かるわよ。
私もあそこ出身だから。
text.official_en: You came from Mysidia, didn’t you? I can tell by your scent. I’m from there, too.

text.jp: あら、あなたたちね。
text.official_en: Oh, it’s you guys.

text.jp:
あら、旅の方ですね。
長旅おつかれでしょう？
お茶でも出せれば良いのですが……。
text.official_en: Ah, a traveler—welcome, welcome. I typically offer my guests some tea, but...
text.real_en: Oh, you're a traveler. You must be tired after such a long journey. I'd love to offer you some tea, but...

text.jp:
あんなものが落ちれば、ただでは済まないだろう。
この国を捨てるのは、たいへん心苦しいが、
遠くの地に逃れるべきか……。
text.official_en: We would not be safe if a mass of that magnitude were to fall out of the sky. It rends my heart to abandon our home, yet ’twould be prudent to flee somewhere far away.

text.jp:
うちの４つになる倅が、
あの浮かんだ大地につれて行けと
言っては聞かぬのだ。
text.official_en: My son of four years implores me to accompany him to the floating land...
text.real_en: My four-year-old son won't stop demanding that I take him to that floating land.

text.jp:
うちの６つになる娘も
大好物でよく食べておるよ。
text.official_en: My daughter, a child of six years, holds a particular fondness for them.
text.real_en: My six-year-old daughter loves them and eats them all the time.

text.jp:
うん！　今日もお天道様が眩しいね。
良い洗濯日和だこと。
text.official_en: My, what a beautiful day! The perfect weather for hanging laundry out to dry.

text.jp: うーむ。どうしたものか……。
text.official_en: Alas, how shall I convince him otherwise?
text.real_en: Hmm... What am I going to do...?

text.jp:
おもてなし……真心をこめてお客様に接する。
それが、この町の流儀なんですよ。
text.official_en: Guests are to be treated with the utmost respect and care. As you can see, we take hospitality very seriously in our town.
text.real_en: Hospitality means treating guests with genuine warmth and care. That's how we do things in this town.

text.jp:
お爺様の代のこと。
この母屋に泥棒が入ってね。
金目の物を全部持って行ったらしい。
text.official_en: During my grandfather’s time, a thief snuck into this house and scurried away with everything of value.

text.jp:
かの国は重力魔法の扱いに
長けていたと聞く。
高度な質量制御で鍛えたとか……
text.official_en: I am told the people of Welkinlond excelled in gravity magic. It is what allowed them to forge the blade by manipulating material density.

text.jp: ここはシアンの町じゃ。
text.official_en: ’Tis the town of Sian.
text.real_en: This is the town of Sian.

text.jp:
この大陸の北に小屋があるんだけどな。
その昔、変わったじいさんが
暮らしていたんだよ。
text.official_en: There’s a small cabin way up in the north of the continent. A strange old man used to live there a long time ago.

text.jp:
この大陸の北に小屋があるんだけどな。
その昔、変わったじいさんが
暮らしていたんだよ。
text.official_en: There’s a small cabin way up in the north of the continent. A strange old man used to live there a long time ago.

text.jp:
これをあげるから
私のこと、みんなにバラさないでよね。
text.official_en: I’ll give you this, but please don’t tell anyone about me, okay?

text.jp:
しかしだ。
ひとつだけ無事だった品があるんだ。
text.official_en: Well, nearly everything.
text.real_en: But there was one thing the thief didn't take.

text.jp:
そ、それは佐助の刀ではないか！
かつて天の国にあったという名刀……！
text.official_en: Th-that is...<text style="italic">Sasuke’s Blade</>! The legendary katana from Welkinlond!

text.jp:
それが、そこに掛かっている
お爺様の書いた掛け軸だ。
見る目のない泥棒だよ。
text.official_en: They left behind that scroll, the one written by my grandfather. It seems the two-bit thief was unable to recognize its worth.

text.jp:
たしか、空の王国について
調査しているとか言ってたな……。
text.official_en: I think he was doing research on—what was it...?—a kingdom in the skies?

text.jp:
たしか、空の王国について
調査しているとか言ってたな……。
text.official_en: I think he was doing research on—what was it...?—a kingdom in the skies?

text.jp:
ただ事でないことは私にもわかります。
どうか、無事に帰ってきてくださいね。
text.official_en: Even I can tell there’s something awful going on. Please, come back safely.

text.jp:
だけどね。
わたしゃ、毎日変わらず洗濯して
干したてのお布団で眠るだけさ。
text.official_en: However, that is none of my concern. I shall keep up with my daily laundry so that I may sleep on a freshly aired futon every night.
text.real_en: But I'll keep doing my laundry every day, just as I always do, and sleeping on freshly aired futons.

text.jp:
どんな町か知りたくば
お主のその両の眼で
しかと見極めるが良いじゃろう。
text.official_en: Should you wish to learn about our ways, I invite you to see them firsthand.
text.real_en: If you want to know what kind of town this is, take a good look with your own eyes.

text.jp:
にしても、なんと滑らかな刃紋だろう。
美しい……実に美しいぞ。
text.official_en: Do you see that pattern along the edge of the sword? It’s called the hamon... I’ve never seen one so beautiful...
text.real_en: And what an incredibly smooth hamon on the blade... Beautiful. Truly beautiful.

text.jp: にゃ～ん？
text.official_en: <text style="italic">Mrow?</>

text.jp: にゃ～ん？
text.official_en: <text style="italic">Mrow?</>

text.jp: にゃ～ん？
text.official_en: <text style="italic">Mrow?</>

text.jp:
のどかで良い町だろう？
こんな日が永久に続けばいいねぇ。
text.official_en: Quite a peaceful town, isn’t it? My only wish is that this peace last forever.

text.jp:
むむむ、「紫電」の気配を感じるぞ。
よもや生きているうちに拝める日が来るとはな。
text.official_en: Can it be...? Is that <text style="italic">Shiden</>? I never thought the day would come when I would lay my eyes upon it...

text.jp:
ものは相談だが、この刀を私にくれまいか？
え？　無理？　なんだ、ケチというものだぞ。
騎士というのはケチだな、まったく。
text.official_en: I have to ask...may I have the sword? No...? Hmph, I did not take you knights for such misers. I have nothing more to say to you, you miserly knights.
text.real_en: Could I ask you something? Would you give me that sword? What, no? That's stingy! Honestly, you knights are so stingy.

text.jp: ん？　その小屋に鍵がかかってたって？
text.official_en: What? You found the cabin and it was locked?

text.jp:
ん？　洗濯はやめないよ。
干したてのお布団で眠るのが
人生の楽しみなんだ。
text.official_en: What? Put it off? Heavens, no! Life offers no greater joy than sleeping on a freshly aired futon.

text.jp:
サクラ師匠の大好きな飴玉、
たくさん用意しておくので！
text.official_en: I’ll have ready all the candy you want, Mistress Sakura!
text.real_en:
I’ll have plenty of your favorite candy
ready for you, Master Sakura!

text.jp:
不吉だねぇ。
これ以上悪いことが起きないといいのだけれど。
text.official_en: Dear me, this bodes ill... I can only hope no harm comes to us.

text.jp:
世界が滅ぶんじゃないかって
誰かが言ってたね。
text.official_en: Someone claimed the world may be ending.

text.jp:
世界を放浪していたら
この町と出会ってね。
帰りたくなくなっちゃったの。
text.official_en: I was traveling the world when I stumbled upon this lovely town. Its warm embrace made me want to settle here for good.
text.real_en: I came across this town while wandering the world, and I just didn't want to go home anymore.

text.jp:
中のものは好きにしろって言ってたから
君がもらってもいいんじゃないか。
text.official_en: The old man said I can do whatever I want with what’s inside, so feel free to take what you need.

text.jp:
匠が鍛えし、名刀を見てはゆかぬか？
もちろん刀以外も取りそろえておる。
心ゆくまで吟味されたし。
text.official_en: Hail, traveler! Might I interest you in some fine blades? Though swords are my pride, I offer wares of many kinds. Pray, come forth and behold craftsmanship wrought by a true master.
text.real_en: Would you care to see a fine blade forged by a master craftsman? We have more than swords, of course. Take your time and choose what suits you.

text.jp:
団子は食べたか？
モチモチで美味いことはもちろんなのだが
その傘の下で食べるとより格別でな。
text.official_en: Have you had the opportunity to taste the dango here? ’Tis chewy as it is devilishly delectable, and delightfully divine when savored ’neath the shade of those umbrellas.
text.real_en: Have you tried the dango? They're delightfully chewy, and taste even better beneath that parasol.

text.jp:
夢か現か、なにかに化かされているのか……
あんなものが宙に浮かんでいるなんて
とても信じられないよ。
text.official_en: Is this a dream or a trick of the spirits? I can hardly believe such a thing is floating in the sky...

text.jp:
大地が空を舞い、
大竜巻がうねりをあげる……。
text.official_en: A land aloft in the sky as a giant tornado takes shape...

text.jp: 家族の命には代えられないからな。
text.official_en: For nothing is worth more than the lives of my family.

text.jp: 悪いけど、頭をなでるのはNGよ。
text.official_en: I’m sorry, but <text style="italic">no</> headscratches, okay?

text.jp:
戦場で孤立した際に己を守るのは、
鍛えあげた技と磨きあげた鎧だけ。
納得の品を選ぶことを進言いたす。
text.official_en: When cast alone upon the field of battle, your only defense lies in your arts and your armor. ’Twould be wise to choose your gear with great care.
text.real_en: If you're stranded alone on the battlefield, all you can rely on are your hard-earned skills and well-maintained armor. I recommend choosing gear you trust.

text.jp:
旅のお供に
便利な道具はいらんかね～？
text.official_en: Items, here! Get yer items for yer travels, here!

text.jp:
空の王国って、なんなんだろうな。
ラから始まる名前だった覚えがあるが……
まぁ、じいさんの空想かな。
text.official_en: Wonder what that “kingdom in the skies” business is about, anyway. I think I heard its name started with “La-,” but I can’t tell if it was just some kooky rambling from the old man.

text.jp:
竜巻のせいで洗濯物が飛ばされないように
しっかりとめないとね。
text.official_en: I shall take extra care to ensure my laundry is not carried off by the winds.

text.jp: 美しいけど、末恐ろしいねぇ。
text.official_en: It’s a beautiful, yet ominous sight...

text.jp:
風流な花が咲いとるじゃろう？
この花の名前はのう、なんでも
偉大な魔道士の名前からつけられているそうじゃぞ。
text.official_en: Beautiful blossoms, are they not? ’Tis said they were named after a great mage.
text.real_en: Aren't those flowers lovely? I hear they were named after a great mage.

text.jp:
飴玉、もっと欲しいんですか？
……事情はよくわかりませんが、
頑張ってくださいね！　師匠たち！
text.official_en: Are you here for more candy? ...I still don’t quite understand what’s going on, but please take care!
text.real_en: Want some more candy? ...I'm not really sure what's going on, but do your best, Masters!
